title: Worker consumer exits after RabbitMQ connection interruption
pattern: During RabbitMQ connection interruptions the worker can exit and remain unavailable until manually restarted; API readiness stays green while async processing stops.
business_impact: Recurring delayed ticket processing and repeated L2 intervention; core synchronous API remains available.
workaround: Use RUN-WORKER-RECOVERY to confirm broker health, restart only the worker, verify consumer count, queue drain, and synthetic recovery.
corrective_action: Review worker reconnect/heartbeat behavior, add a permanent resilience change through CHG-1001, and retain alerting on queue depth plus zero consumers.
